text:
Elaine Park: Quick preflight — need a short checklist for the postlaunch leadflow page. Focus: keyword canonicalization, internal links from docs, redirect fallbacks for old campaign URLs, and schema for webinar registration microdata. Can we assemble in the next hour? @Alex @Suresh

Alex Chen: On it — I'll pull the sitemap and surface any orphan pages and top referrers. ETA ~40m.

Suresh Iyer: I can run a redirect sweep against last PROD deploy and flag loops or 5xxs. Send me the old path list and I'll compare.

Priya Patel: For schema: plan to include Event + Offer + registrationMethod, plus a small FAQ JSON-LD snippet. I'll paste an example below for the landing.

Elaine Park: Also need an anchor-text list for the top 5 referral pages so we can wire internal links. Short bullets are fine.

Alex Chen: Quick findings from initial crawl: two semi-orphaned pages — /blog/launch-thoughts and /guides/onboarding-checklist. Recommend linking from /product/leadflow and /docs/getting-started. Top referrers: docs, integrations page, support articles, partner blog.

Suresh Iyer: Suggested redirect rules for nginx (temporary 302s for verification, then 301):
```nginx
# old campaign -> canonical leadflow
location = /old-campaign-lead {
    return 302 /product/leadflow;
}
# preserve trailing slash variants and strip utm params in canonicalization layer
```
I'll run these in staging first.

Priya Patel: JSON-LD example (short):
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Leadflow product webinar",
  "startDate": "2026-04-15T10:00:00-07:00",
  "location": {"@type": "VirtualLocation", "url": "https://redwood.ai/webinar/leadflow"},
  "offers": {"@type": "Offer", "url": "https://redwood.ai/register/leadflow", "availability": "https://schema.org/InStock"},
  "organizer": {"@type": "Organization", "name": "Redwood Inference"}
}
```
Also adding a short FAQ snippet for SERP enhancement.

Dana M.: Note — canonical header should prefer the clean path (/product/leadflow) and we should strip tracking queries server-side. Add a canonical-link header and 301 canonicalize common query permutations.

Alex Chen: I'll update the internal-linking spreadsheet and assign owners for each inbound referrer. @Elaine can you confirm keyword priority: "lead routing" vs "inbound lead routing"?

Elaine Park: Primary: "inbound lead routing". Keep "lead routing" as secondary anchor variants.

Priya Patel: I'll add FAQ Qs: 1) How do I register? 2) What integrations work with Leadflow? 3) How do I change my registration? I'll post the JSON-LD and small FAQ HTML snippets to the SEO snippets doc.

Suresh Iyer: Sweep report: no 500s in staging, but found two 301 loops caused by legacy campaign redirect mapping. I patched one loop (old-campaign -> middle -> old-campaign). Fix committed to staging branch.

Elaine Park: Can we prioritize schema + redirect fixes for tonight's deploy? We need CTAs live for morning traffic. :pray:

Alex Chen: Yes — I'll PR the internal links and the redirect map. Requesting review from @Suresh and @Priya.

Suresh Iyer: PR up in 15m, will review and run the redirect tests.

Priya Patel: JSON-LD + FAQ saved to /docs/seo/snippets.md and linked in the PR.

Elaine Park: Perfect. I'll notify CS to update CTAs after the deploy and confirm the canonical mapping. Thanks team :rocket:

Alex Chen: thumbs up :thumbsup:

Suresh Iyer: running final smoke tests now.

Priya Patel: small follow-up — let's A/B the FAQ snippet visibility for two weeks postlaunch to monitor impressions.

Elaine Park: Agreed. Adding to postlaunch checklist.
